answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a sable that rotates unpredictably. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the ledge of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Net effect on the ember: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1o6v3.
